title: Kissed Galician Turkey Ham Crema Catalana
description: A light, fermented custard dessert with crisp fried turkey ham and a sugar‑free caramel finish.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a 2L saucepan over medium and add turkey ham cubes, stir‑frying until golden, about 3 minutes; set aside.
Pour milk, almond milk, kefir, add cinnamon, vanilla, lemon zest into the same saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer, 4–5 minutes.
In a bowl whisk egg yolks with erythritol until pale; add a pinch of salt.
Tempering: slowly pour a small amount of the hot milk into the yolks while whisking continuously.
Stir the tempered yolk mixture back into the saucepan; add the fried ham and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until custard thickens to a glaze consistency, about 5–7 minutes.
Transfer custard into 4 ramekins; sprinkle grated nutmeg on top.
Place ramekins in a preheated oven at 160°C and bake until edges set but center still slightly jiggly, 12–15 minutes.
Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate 2 hours before serving.
Just before serving, dust lightly with powdered erythritol for a sweet finish.
Serve chilled with fresh berries or a sugar‑free caramel glaze (optional).
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
